▖ ▖ ▗ █▜▛█ ▛▛▛▛▀ Clappie
Get Started
What is this? A Claude Code manager using plain text files. Requirements You need Mac, Bun, and tmux installed. Installation Get up and running in minutes. Glossary Learn the terminology used in Clappie.
Features
Sidekick Background manager for heartbeat and sidekicks. Heartbeat Schedule AI tasks with plain text files. Sidekicks Spawn autonomous Claude sessions. Displays Terminal UIs with buttons and forms. Notifications Process external events through a pipeline. Chores Human approval queue for risky actions. Recall Persistent memory across sessions. CLI Self-documenting command line interface.
Ways to Chat
Terminal Interactive displays in your terminal. Heartbeat Get periodic pings on a schedule. Remote Access via SSH and Tailscale. Bots Chat via Telegram, Slack, or iMessage.
Integrations
Built-in Telegram, Slack, and iMessage support. Build Your Own Create custom integrations with skills. OAuth Helper Handle authentication flows easily. Webhook Routing Route webhooks to your skills.

Folder Structure How the project is organized. Environment Variables Configure Clappie with .env files. All CLI Commands Complete command reference.

Reference

Folder Structure

The interactive file tree in the sidebar shows the complete project structure. Click folders to expand, and hover over files to see descriptions.

Key directories:

  • .claude/skills/ - All skill modules (clappie, integrations, whisper)
  • chores/ - Human approval queue (bots/ for heartbeat, humans/ for pending)
  • notifications/ - External event pipeline (dirty/ → clean/)
  • recall/ - Persistent memory, logs, settings, and files

Environment Variables

# Required for Whisper/TTS
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...

# Front.com email integration
FRONT_CLIENT_ID=...
FRONT_CLIENT_SECRET=...

# Telegram bot
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=...

# Slack bot
SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=xoxb-...
SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET=...

All CLI Commands

# Discovery
clappie list                    # List everything
clappie list skills             # Just skills
clappie list displays           # Just displays

# Displays
clappie push             # Open a display
clappie pop                     # Go back
clappie toast "message"         # Show notification
clappie close                   # Close display

# Sidekick
clappie sidekick                # Start all background apps
clappie sidekick           # Start one app
clappie sidekick stop [app]     # Stop app(s)

# Sidekicks
clappie sidekick "prompt"        # Spawn autonomous agent
clappie send  "message"     # Send to sidekick
clappie complete  "summary" # End sidekick

# OAuth
clappie oauth auth    # Start OAuth flow
clappie oauth token   # Get access token
clappie oauth status            # Show all tokens

# Cleanup
clappie kill-all                # Kill everything
clappie kill-sidekick           # Kill sidekick only
